prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original FRAME ACADEMY Color & Mood course cover, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: A precise photographic still life with one cobalt-blue glass vessel, one red-orange persimmon, and rust-colored fabric resting on a dark navy tabletop.
Composition/framing: Landscape editorial medium still life; balanced asymmetric grouping, glass vessel around left third and persimmon lower right, fabric arranged in one broad natural fold. Clean visual hierarchy and uncluttered composition.
Lighting/mood: controlled soft directional studio light, credible glass reflections and refracted blue light, rich deep shadows. Color relationships are bold but restrained and believable.
Materials/textures: real transparent cobalt glass, subtly textured fruit skin and dry sepals, tactile matte rust linen, matte navy surface.
Constraints: no text, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, no extra objects, no illustration or CGI. Produce one finished original photograph.
